paraphrase: By inner heat, bliss-warmth blazes by itself; by the illusory body, attachment and aversion are self-liberated; by dream, delusion is self-liberated; by clear light, ignorance is self-liberated; by transference and the intermediate state, one attains the enjoyment body.
notes: Reference from memory; the text is not available locally. Pattern recalled; exact pairing of dharma and fruit is low confidence.
